services.desc: 90 minute Big Island helicopter tour from Kona. Experience an epic Kohala Coast helicopter tour featuring Mauna Loa, Mauna Kea and Hualālai volcanoes as well as the Big Island’s most dramatic waterfalls. Fly above four volcanic mountains, lush tropical valleys, and the towering waterfalls that make the Kohala Coast one of Hawaiʻi Island’s most spectacular landscapes. Explore the lands shaped by Goddess Pele and the historic regions once ruled by King Kamehameha while experiencing the dramatic geology, coastline, and rainforests of North Hawaiʻi. blurb: Rainbow Helicopters offers scenic and private helicopter tours over Hawaii's iconic landscapes including volcanoes, coastlines, waterfalls, and coffee farms. Guests can choose from open-door or doors-off flights, private charters, and luxury picnic experiences with gourmet meals. Tours highlight landmarks such as Mauna Kea, Hualālai Volcano, Kona Coast, and Pearl Harbor.
